messages:
Oren: hi all — Oren here, first day! trying to learn the who-to-ping map so i don't spam folks. quick list: 1) who owns routing/fallback policies (e.g., model downgrade rules)? 2) who signs Dedicated console/access and quota bumps? 3) who gets paged for production errors vs model-quality issues? also where's the canonical owner roster? thanks! :wave:

Lily: welcome Oren! Routing/fallback = eng-platform (they maintain routing rules and policy docs). For owners roster check /handbooks/owners.md — it's the single source we try to keep updated.

Ben: for access: file an IT request (okta workflow). Approvals are manager + team lead for Dedicated access. If you need Dedicated capacity increases, submit the capacity form (finance + eng-ops sign off).

Infra-bot: Notice: access request template available at https://internal.redwood.com/forms/dedicated-access.

Cate: paging flow: eng-sre oncall is the first pager for any P1/P0 perf or availability incidents. eng-sre triages and escalates to eng-platform (capacity/routing), eng-runtime (kernel/kv/cache), or eng-ml (quality/regression). If a customer is impacted, tag #customer-impact and notify CS.

Paloma: extra tips — for short-lived test elevation include `temp-access: 48h` in the notes. For experimental routing tests, coordinate with eng-platform (they prefer a short PR + changelog entry).

Oren: awesome, thanks. can someone paste the minimal access request I should file?

Ben: minimal template below — paste into IT ticket:
```
Subject: Dedicated Console Access - oren@example.com
Requester: Oren (oren@example.com)
Manager: <manager-name>
Team: <team-name>
Reason: onboarding + need to validate routing for feature A
Requested resources: Dedicated console read, project <proj-id>
Expected QPS: 40
Approvers: manager + eng-ops
```

Oren: filed IT ticket and CC'd manager. thanks everyone! DMing if approval stalls.
